text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages and elevated basophils. Mild hypoglycemia, low total protein, and low liver transaminases are also present. These findings suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic disease, or acute infection, but SARS-CoV-2 is not detected. Clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
